widgets_values:
subject_definitions

<Subject 1> is the same adult Chinese woman shown in Picture 1. Preserve her long black hair, body proportions and dusty-pink fitted Pilates outfit. Her face, eyes, mouth and facial reflections must never be visible.

<Subject 2> is the exact portable cup shown in Picture 2. Strictly preserve its pearly pale-pink textured body, rounded shape, polished silver domed lid, silver collar, original printed branding and pink wrist strap.

<Environment 1> is the premium boutique Pilates studio shown in Picture 3. The studio remains a softly blurred supporting background.

summary

Create a 15-second vertical 9:16 faceless product commercial. The pale-pink portable cup is the absolute visual focus and appears prominently throughout the entire video, occupying approximately 50% to 70% of the frame.

Show only the woman’s hands, arms, shoulder-down body or rear silhouette. Never reveal her face directly or through reflections.

Use one continuous young adult female Mandarin off-screen voiceover. Complete the entire narration before 00:15.000.

No empty establishing shots, dominant Pilates exercise shots, subtitles, captions, title cards, new text, extra logos, watermarks or additional people.

retention_analysis

Strictly preserve the cup from Picture 2. Do not change its shape, pink color, texture, silver lid, proportions, wrist strap or existing branding. Keep the lid closed and do not show liquid.

The cup must remain the largest and sharpest subject in every shot. Do not allow the woman, studio or Pilates equipment to dominate the frame. Prevent the woman’s face from appearing in the polished lid or other reflective surfaces.

detailed_description

[Shot 1]
00:00.000–00:03.300. Immediate product hero opening. <Subject 2> stands upright on a light stone pedestal inside <Environment 1>, occupying approximately 65% of the frame. Begin with a macro view of the pearly pink texture, then make a short smooth orbit revealing the silver lid, complete cup shape and wrist strap. The softly blurred Pilates studio provides context.
<Subject 1> (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 普拉提练习，是一场与身体的温柔对话。</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:03.300
00:03.300–00:07.300. Shoulder-down product demonstration. <Subject 1>’s hands gently lift <Subject 2> and turn it slightly toward the light. The cup occupies approximately 60% of the frame. Show the material texture, silver hardware and pink wrist strap in detail without covering the branding. Her head remains outside the frame.
<Subject 1> (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 这款柔粉随行水杯，精致有质感，轻巧又便携。</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:07.300
00:07.300–00:10.900. Low close tracking shot focused on <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> carries the cup beside her body with the pink strap looped around her wrist. The cup stays centered and sharply focused while the Pilates reformer and her clothing remain softly blurred. Frame only her hand, forearm and shoulder-down body.
<Subject 1> (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 课前准备，课中补水，陪伴每一次呼吸与伸展。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:10.900
00:10.900–00:15.000. Premium final product close-up. <Subject 1> places <Subject 2> upright in the foreground beside the Pilates reformer. The cup occupies approximately 70% of the frame. Her cropped hands briefly straighten the wrist strap and then leave the frame. Finish with a slow push toward the complete cup, keeping its form and material sharply visible. No face or facial reflection appears.
<Subject 1> (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 保持专注，享受当下，让每一次练习，更加从容自在。</d>

overall_soundscape

Clean studio ambience, subtle hand and fabric movement, and a soft product placement sound. No drinking, pouring or lid-opening sounds. Keep the voiceover clear and dominant.

non_diegetic_music

Soft premium commercial music with delicate piano, airy ambient pads and minimal light percussion. Keep it below the narration and end precisely at 00:15.000.
